args.body: Hi Dora, thanks for joining Slack! I just visited your website www.dora-website.com and here's my honest feedback: I loved the personal touch with your name and photo, but the design feels a bit dated. I'd suggest updating to a modern template and adding some clear calls-to-action to your homepage.
